residual_squareclass_normalization.H: odd_sf(D0*C*D), the positive odd squarefree kernel after toggling the C and D support bits against D0
residual_squareclass_normalization.proof: the two coefficients have the same sign eta*sign(D0), the same dyadic parity delta+e+f, and at every odd prime the exponent parity is v_q(D0)+1_{q|C}+1_{q|D}; removing mu leaves an even valuation at every place

generalized_norm_equations.AY_specialization: A=B=1 and mu=1 recovers the BH difference-of-squares equations

old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.setup: q is an odd prime in P,M,a,b,a-b,a+b, hence q does not divide Q
old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.first_square_term_strictly_dominates: the corresponding full-cover square equation is Q_q-soluble iff hAB=0 and Legendre(AB0,q)=+1
old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.negative_mu_term_strictly_dominates: the corresponding full-cover square equation is Q_q-soluble iff hAB=hmu and Legendre(-mu0*AB0,q)=+1
old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.tie_normalization: after extracting the common even q-power and a square unit, write the remaining factor as z^2-mu0; let n=v_q(z^2-mu0), w0=(z^2-mu0)/q^n
old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.tie_square_criterion: n mod 2 must equal hAB and Legendre(w0*AB0,q)=+1
old_six_universal_odd_q_taxonomy.completeness: necessary and sufficient for the individual odd-q square equation; there is no later Hensel digit obstruction once valuation parity and normalized unit residue are fixed

Q_reservoir_generalization.setup: q is an odd prime dividing Q=a^2+b^2; q divides none of P,M,a,b,a-b,a+b,A,B,mu,Tminus,Tplus
Q_reservoir_generalization.reason: if q divided both r and s, the two coupled conics would force q to divide both primitive U=A*u^2 and V=B*v^2
Q_reservoir_generalization.derivation: at least one of r,s is a q-unit; reducing the corresponding full-cover equation modulo q gives A*B times a square equal to -mu times a square, while q|a^2+b^2 makes -1 a q-square
Q_reservoir_generalization.failure_consequence: if the row fails for one odd q|Q, the entire AW squareclass branch has no Q_q receiver point, independently of the receiver-point ratio
Q_reservoir_generalization.nontie_after_row: negative-mu-leading cases pass the leading residue gate; square-leading cases additionally require Legendre(A*B,q)=+1
Q_reservoir_generalization.tie_after_row: the generalized tie criterion above applies with hAB=hmu=0; n must be even and Legendre(w0*A*B,q)=+1

exact_fixed_p_diagnostics.interpretation: the new row is not implied by the existing AE local-row filter and gives exact branch pruning, but neither diagnostic parameter is completely eliminated
